question: Find the HCF of (54)/(9),3(9)/(17) {and} (36)/(51).
solution:
**Given:**

(54)/(9),3(9)/(17) {and} (36)/(51)

Concept used:

HCF = the greatest number which divides each of the two or more numbers

HCF(a/b, c/d) = HCF(a, c)/LCM(b, d)

Calculation: 

We have, (54)/(9) = 6

3(9)/(17) = (60)/(17)

And, (36)/(51)= (12)/(17)

LCM(1, 17 and 17) = 17

HCF(6, 60 and 12) = 6

So, HCF(6, 60/17 and 12/17) = (6)/(17)

∴ The required HCF is **(6)/(17).**
